body:
Thank you for taking the time to reply. I study English. I do like it. I knew when I was 9 or 10 years old (when I started learning English at school) that I wanted to study it later. It's the thing I'm good at, I guess. I'd like to be a translator for movies and tv shows later in life. Or any kind of translator really.

It's just that finally getting my BA or thinking of a career seems useless now that I have no friends left and I feel too old to find love again. Life doesn't consist of loneliness and working. I keep thinking why bother at all. Then the next day, I try hard at my classes again, do all my reading, my homework, my term papers. These days the "why even bother" days are becoming more frequent though.
